# nself.yaml

← [[Configuration]]

---

`nself.yaml` (or `nself.yml`) is the project manifest `nself build` reads to decide which plugins and bundles belong to the project. It holds no configuration values: those live in `.env` files (see [[Config-Env-Vars]]).

## Keys nself reads

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `app` | string | Project name. |
| `bundle` | string | One bundle to install, expanded from the bundle catalog. |
| `bundles` | list of strings | Several bundles. |
| `plugins` | list of strings, or a map with `free` and `pro` lists | Plugins to wire in. |

Every other key is not read. The same list, as a machine contract, is `schemas/nself-yaml.v1.schema.json`, generated by `tools/schemagen` from the `ProjectManifest` Go type (never hand-edited; `make schemas` regenerates it and `make contract-check` fails when it drifts).

```yaml
app: myapp
bundle: task
plugins:
  free: [cron, notify]
  pro: [ai]
x-display-name: My App      # extension key: ignored
```

## The x- rule

A key that starts with `x-` is an extension. nself ignores it and the validator accepts it, at the top level and inside the `plugins` map. Use it for app metadata that tools other than nself read (a display name, an owner, a tier). Rename an unread key `tier` to `x-tier` to keep it without a finding.

## Validation

`nself config validate` also checks `nself.yaml` when the project has one. It runs after the existing validators. Each finding goes to stderr as `file:line:col: severity: path: [code] message (fix)`.

| Code | Finding |
|---|---|
| E436 | An unknown key, at any depth the types describe (for example `plugins.required`). The fix names a close match when there is one (`project` suggests `app`) and the `x-` rename. |
| E435 | A syntax error, an unreadable file, or a value of the wrong type (`plugins: 7`, a plugin entry that is a map, a non-string `app`). |

| Mode | Findings are | Exit status |
|---|---|---|
| v1.4 (default) | warnings | unchanged: `config validate` exits as it did without the check |
| v1.5 (opt in; see [[Compat-V15]]) | errors | 1 when there is any finding |

See [[Compat-V15]] and [[error-codes]]. `nself build` parsing is not changed by the validator: a file that builds today still builds.

## Reference apps

The reference-app manifests carry keys nothing reads (`display_name`, `version`, `tier`, `auth_mode`, `services`, `project`). In v1.4 they show up as warnings. The migration to `x-` keys is done in the reference-app repos, not here.
